name: Arcus senilis
summary: Grey-white lipid ring in the peripheral corneal stroma with a clear zone at the limbus; common with age.

revealed_by.diffuse: Grey-white ring at the corneal periphery, separated from the limbus by a clear lucid interval.
revealed_by.sclerotic_scatter: The ring glows when the cornea is lit from the limbus.

teaching_points: In patients under 50, arcus warrants a lipid profile.

provenance.source: Kanski's Clinical Ophthalmology, 9th ed.; values render-calibrated
